name: Jalpi Login and Notifications
author: Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
Jalpi Login and Notifications is a powerful WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that integrates WhatsApp Business API messaging into your store. It enables automated WhatsApp order notifications, secure WhatsApp OTP login/register, and advanced messaging workflows, designed to enhance customer communication and checkout experience.

Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd. (Official WhatsApp Business Partner) manages Jalpi and other communication products. The company has been serving 65,000+ businesses since 2008, with over 3,000+ businesses using its WhatsApp API ecosystem.

This plugin provides two primary capabilities:

1. Automated WhatsApp Notifications for WooCommerce

Send automated WhatsApp messages when customers place orders, update orders, or complete purchases. Notifications use approved WhatsApp Business templates and support key dynamic placeholders such as order ID, total amount, items, customer details, shipping address, and tracking links.

Ideal for:
* E-commerce stores
* WooCommerce merchants
* Online marketplaces
who want real-time communication with customers using WhatsApp — the most widely used messaging platform.

2. WhatsApp OTP Authentication

Enable secure login and registration for WordPress and WooCommerce using WhatsApp OTP. Features include:

  • 2FA-style authentication
  • 200+ country support
  • Rate limiting
  • IP lockouts
  • Nonce-protected AJAX
  • Phone normalization
  • WooCommerce phone matching logic

This improves both customer experience and store security.

Key Capabilities

  • Automated WhatsApp notifications for WooCommerce events
  • WhatsApp OTP login and registration
  • Template-based messaging with dynamic parameter mapping
  • Multiple flows per WooCommerce event
  • Template browser and preview
  • Real-time API connection tester
  • Logs with masked data
  • Caching system for performance
  • Nonce verification, rate limits, lockouts, sanitized inputs

Company Information

Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd. is the parent organization and Official WhatsApp Business Partner responsible for developing and maintaining Jalpi and Authyo. All product lines, including Jalpi’s WhatsApp Business Platform, are internally built and supported by Konceptwise.

Product Association

This plugin is part of the Jalpi product suite. All associated domains — including jalpi.com and authyo.io — are owned and operated by Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt. Ltd.

Ownership & Submission Clarification

This plugin is submitted using the official Konceptwise developer account. No third-party company is involved in ownership, development, or maintenance.

Key Features

WooCommerce Integration

  • Automated WhatsApp notifications for all WooCommerce order events
  • Supports order placed, processing, completed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded
  • Template-based messaging using approved WhatsApp Business templates
  • Dynamic placeholder mapping
  • Multiple flows per event (advanced automation)
  • Header media/text support
  • Multilingual template support
  • Idempotency logic to prevent duplicate sends

WhatsApp OTP Authentication

  • Login via WhatsApp OTP
  • Registration with OTP (email optional)
  • Supports 200+ countries
  • Phone number normalization
  • WooCommerce phone matching
  • Rate limits & lockout rules
  • Nonce-protected AJAX system

Admin Features

  • Dashboard with API connection status
  • Template browser & testing tools
  • Flow builder (visual automation workflow)
  • Debug log viewer (masked data)
  • Cache management panel
  • OTP settings panel

Privacy & Data

Data Collected

  • Phone numbers (stored in user meta)
  • Email addresses (optional)
  • WooCommerce order details (for placeholders)
  • IP addresses (rate limiting)

Data Sharing

  • Shared only with Jalpi API (Official WhatsApp Business API partner)
  • No third-party sharing beyond Jalpi
  • All data transmitted over HTTPS

Security

  • Masked sensitive data
  • Secure API key storage
  • Nonce validation
  • Rate limiting and IP lockouts
  • File + transient caching

Please review the Jalpi Privacy Policy: https://jalpi.com/privacy-policy/

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the Jalpi WhatsApp Business API for sending WhatsApp notifications and OTP messages.

API Endpoints

  • POST /SendTemplateMessage
  • GET /GetConnectionStatus
  • GET /GetTemplateList
  • GET /GetCountryListWithCode

The country list API is cached for 30 days and does not send personal data.

Security

  • HTTPS enforced
  • API key authentication
  • Masked error logs

Shortcodes

  • [jalpi_ln_login] – WhatsApp OTP login form
  • [jalpi_ln_register] – WhatsApp OTP registration form

Backward compatible:
* [bwj_login]
* [bwj_register]

Support

For support or onboarding assistance, visit:
https://jalpi.com/contact/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/jalpi-login-and-notifications/ or install via WordPress Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Jalpi Login → Settings.
  4. Enter your Jalpi API Key and test your API connection.
  5. (Optional) Configure WooCommerce message flows.
  6. (Optional) Enable WhatsApp OTP login/registration.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Jalpi account?

Yes, sign up at https://jalpi.com/ for WhatsApp Business API access. A free plan is available for testing OTP and notifications.

Can I use this plugin without WooCommerce?

Yes, WhatsApp OTP login and registration work with any WordPress site. Order notifications require WooCommerce.

How many OTP attempts are allowed?

The default limit is 3 attempts with a 30-minute lockout. You can adjust this in OTP settings.

How do I enable WhatsApp login?

Enable it in the plugin settings and add the shortcode [jalpi_ln_login] to any page.

Is customer data secure?

Yes. Data is stored in WordPress user meta, logs mask sensitive information, and all API requests use HTTPS with nonce validation.

Does it support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes, it works with all WooCommerce order types including subscriptions, bookings, and pre-orders.

Can I send WhatsApp messages in multiple languages?

Yes, you can choose language-specific WhatsApp templates.

Do customers prefer WhatsApp notifications over email?

WhatsApp delivers significantly higher open and engagement rates, making it ideal for order updates and real-time communication.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

No. Jalpi provides access to the Official WhatsApp Business API, which is different from the WhatsApp Business mobile app.
